visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor sports facility with green artificial turf, two men stand facing each other. The younger man on the left wears a blue sleeveless tank top, while the older man on the right wears an orange and purple sports jersey. They are talking and gesturing towards a target in the background. (2) The camera pans slightly as the younger man prepares to throw a baseball. He is seen from the side, aiming at a purple-framed net target with numbered plates in the distance. He throws several balls, showing concentrated facial expressions and follow-through body mechanics. (3) The older man takes his turn, standing in the same position. He throws baseballs towards the target, with his back partially to the camera. The setting remains consistent with netting surrounding the area. (4) The younger man returns to the frame pushing a large metal shopping cart filled to the brim with white baseballs. Both men are laughing and smiling broadly, creating a humorous atmosphere. (5) The older man continues throwing balls from the cart in rapid succession. The lighting is even and bright across the indoor field. (6) Finally, a ball strikes one of the numbered plates. Both men celebrate enthusiastically; the younger man jumps up and down with his arms raised, clapping loudly, while the older man smiles and points towards the target.
